rules.rule: One Task = one root post (the Task card) in the channel; Conversation.source_thread = root post id.
One Brainstorm = one root post (the Brainstorm card) plus thread.
The card is edited in place on every state transition (title, status badge, assignee, verification_status, pending approvals, latest progress, artifact/document links, sub-task join status).
Every state transition leaves exactly one thread reply; replies are never edited or deleted (immutable log).
Progress posts are coalesced per Task in 10-second windows (one reply per window with coalesced_count).
Bodies over 16,000 characters are stored as an Artifact and only linked from the card/reply.
A sub-Task posts a link card in the parent thread and has its own root post and thread.
Card buttons (Accept, Submit, Approve/Reject, Verify pass/fail, Cancel) are conveniences; the server re-evaluates permissions at callback time.
Duplicate clicks of the same button are processed once by idempotency key (provider_instance + post_id + action + nonce).
A command inside a Task/Brainstorm thread targets that thread's subject when the id is omitted.
Successful command responses are posted publicly in the thread; errors are ephemeral with cause and correct example and create no side effects.
HIGH and CRITICAL approvals cannot be decided by a button; the button shows web re-authentication guidance only.
Agent utterances are posted by the Agent-Colab bot with override_username/override_icon_url set by the server, or the [agent-name] prefix fallback when overrides are disallowed (P0-10 spike decides).
